title: B-Roll: U.S. Marines conduct F-35B Lightning II flight operations during Arctic Edge 25
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Fighter Attack Squadron (VMFA) 533, Marine Aircraft Group 31, 2nd Marine Aircraft Wing, conduct F-35B Lightning II flight operations during ARCTIC EDGE 2025 (AE25) at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, Aug. 11, 2025. The F-35B is a fifth-generation stealth fighter designed for short takeoff and vertical landing (STOVL) allowing it to operate from ships and austere environments to conduct air-to-air, air-to-ground and electronic warfare operations. AE25 is a NORAD and U.S. Northern Command-led homeland defense exercise designed to improve readiness, demonstrate capabilities, and enhance Joint and Allied Force interoperability in the Arctic. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Grant Schirmer)
keywords: USNORTHCOM, F-35B Lightning II, HomelandDefense, #AlwaysVigilant, #arcticsecurity, AE25
